agent_id.description: Recipient agent. Without conversation_id, starts a new hidden conversation. Required when conversation_id is default.

conversation_id.description: Existing recipient conversation. A conv-... ID identifies its agent; default also requires agent_id.

computer.description: Optional execution computer: cloud, an online computer name, device ID, or connection ID. Omit to keep the conversation's active or saved computer, with Cloud sandbox fallback.
